title: #75 Personal Life
prompt: Nowadays, people who devote too much time to their job leave very little time for their personal and private life. How widespread is the problem? What problem will this shortage of time cause?

promptSegments.text: Nowadays, people who devote too much time to their job leave very little time for their personal and private life.
What problem will this shortage of time cause?

requirements.en: Answer every direct question in the prompt.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that spending too much time at work is a widespread problem. The first body paragraph explains that high work pressure is the main cause. The second body paragraph suggests that changing working hours is an effective solution.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that spending too much time at work is a widespread problem. The first body paragraph explains that high work pressure is the main cause. The second body paragraph suggests that changing working hours is an effective solution.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay maintains a clear structure: Introduction (stating the problem), Body 1 (identifying the cause/problem), Body 2 (offering a solution), and Conclusion (restating the stance). Vocabulary is kept simple and concrete.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay maintains a clear structure: Introduction (stating the problem), Body 1 (identifying the cause/problem), Body 2 (offering a solution), and Conclusion (restating the stance). Vocabulary is kept simple and concrete.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that overworking is a widespread problem, first by identifying the pressure from modern workplaces as the main cause, and second by suggesting that setting clearer boundaries is an effective solution.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that overworking is a widespread problem, first by identifying the pressure from modern workplaces as the main cause, and second by suggesting that setting clearer boundaries is an effective solution.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay maintains a consistent B2 level, using simple linking words and avoiding complex academic structures. The structure strictly follows the required PEEL format for both body paragraphs.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay maintains a consistent B2 level, using simple linking words and avoiding complex academic structures. The structure strictly follows the required PEEL format for both body paragraphs.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The primary cause of overworking is the intense pressure within competitive professional environments, which leads to diminished personal boundaries and burnout.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The primary cause of overworking is the intense pressure within competitive professional environments, which leads to diminished personal boundaries and burnout.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A practical solution involves implementing stricter work-life balance policies, which helps establish clear boundaries and improves mental health.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A practical solution involves implementing stricter work-life balance policies, which helps establish clear boundaries and improves mental health.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not ignore a direct question in the prompt.
promptTraps.vi: Không bỏ qua câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
